ly_mito.src: Mito Recharge sell sheet ND812 (Rev. 2/25; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAvs1Q, re-opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 3 capsules (30 servings) as listed under the shared 'mito' entry above, including vitamin K1 (as phytonadione) 250 mcg and magnesium (as malate and ascorbate) 75 mg; directions three capsules daily.
